facts.statement: The genus Yumenornis was first named by Ya-Ming Wang, Jingmai O'Connor, Da-Qing Li, and Hai-Lu You in 2013.
facts.quote: Yumenornis was first named by Ya-Ming Wang, Jingmai O'Connor, Da-Qing Li and Hai-Lu You in 2013

facts.statement: Yumenornis lived during the Early Cretaceous in the Xiagou Formation of the Changma Basin in northwestern China.
facts.quote: Yumenornis is an extinct genus of basal ornithuromorph dinosaurs known from the Early Cretaceous Xiagou Formation of Changma Basin, Gansu Province of northwestern China

facts.statement: Yumenornis is classified within the class Aves, the subclass Avialae, and the unranked family Ornithuromorpha.
facts.quote: unranked_classis: Avialae classis: Aves unranked_familia: Ornithuromorpha

facts.statement: Yumenornis is an extinct genus of basal ornithuromorph bird.
facts.quote: Yumenornis es un género extinto de ave ornituromorfa basal

facts.statement: The time range for Yumenornis is estimated to be between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)
